## Photo tips for a great NEON duo video

### One person per photo

Each photo should show only the person who will dance. Crop out anyone else.

### Face clearly visible

Front-facing or a slight angle, even light, no sunglasses or heavy filters.

### Waist-up or full body

A photo that shows the shoulders and upper body gives the AI more to work with.

### Real photos only

No screenshots, celebrities, public figures or music-video stills. Both people must be 18+ and give their consent.
